head: SERIF
dzh: 大标题、黑线栅格、红色点题
den: Big headlines, black-rule grid, a red accent
nzh: 标题很大、粗细对比强烈；用粗细两种黑线分栏；版式不对称、留白多；红色只点一两处，几乎不用圆角和阴影
nen: Very large headlines with strong weight contrast; thick and thin black rules for columns; asymmetric layout with space; red in one or two places, almost no radius or shadow
